articleTitle: Drop-Off or Ease In? What Actually Works for Daycare Transitions at 12 Months
imageHeadline: The Drop-Off Dilemma: Quick Exit or Gradual Goodbye?
imageSubtext: What research says about daycare transitions at 12 months
pinTitle: Daycare Transitions at 12 Months: What Actually Works for Separation Anxiety
pinDescription: Your toddler has separation anxiety and you're starting daycare. The research supports both gradual settling-in and quick goodbyes—but in different phases. Learn what helps during the initial transition versus daily drop-offs, and why drawn-out farewells often backfire.

items.label: Introduce space gradually with you as secure base
Build predictable routines and goodbye rituals
Keep daily drop-offs short and consistent
Trust teachers to comfort after you leave
